config_hash_definition: sha256 over json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8') of the 'config' object in this file

config.scope: DEVELOPMENT-ONLY LightGBM equal-information comparison (PREP frozen; no real-data execution). No confirm claim, no adoption claim, no production promotion; 2026 rows remain CLOSED.
config.readiness_gate: PENDING READINESS GATE: not yet READY. The standing conditional authorization applies after READY; until then no real-data fit or score happens under this config.
config.lgbm_hyperparameters_source: lgbm_equal_info_adapter.py LGBM_EQUAL_INFO_CONFIG (copied verbatim; any change is a new config, not an edit)

adapter.tests: test_lgbm_equal_info_adapter.py + test_auto_tracking.py (lake count-eval-v1; byte-identical repo mirror test_auto_tracking.py)

equal_information_contract.features_binding: identical to the both-EW logistic reference P1_H3_incumbent_refit (6 frozen B features + ew_pitcher + ew_batter; comparison.py FEAT_H3)
equal_information_contract.rows: identical rows for both candidates per fold: same base_train pool, same calibration sub-block, same eval frame; per-fold eval identity hash (sorted (game_pk, at_bat_number, batter)) asserted identical across candidates when executed
equal_information_contract.folds_binding: same registered dev folds as the both-EW logistic reference (block_2024H1 / block_2024H2 / block_2025H1), same fold_calibration_rule (60 PA-bearing-day sigmoid sub-block), same metric definitions

training_only_tuning.early_stopping: permitted on ONE inner block carved out of base_train ONLY (last 20% of distinct base_train slate dates); verified structurally by test_inner_block_is_train_carveout_not_eval
training_only_tuning.prohibited_sources: no early stopping on the calibration sub-block, no early stopping on or any label use from the dev-assessment frames; the eval frame is never visible to fitting
training_only_tuning.no_search: no hyperparameter search outside the inner-carve-out early stop; the frozen config above is recorded, not searched
training_only_tuning.dev_assessment_labels: dev-assessment labels are NEVER used for training, stopping, scaling, or calibration

evaluation.bootstrap: paired slate-date bootstrap, block-stratified, shared draw stream; 1-D replicate shape assertions before elementwise subtraction
evaluation.calibration_lane: CAL SEPARATE: sigmoid calibration on the calibration sub-block ONLY, same definition as the executed logistic adapters; reported separately, never merged with RAW; no CAL contrast claims

baseline_binding.reference: P1_H3_incumbent_refit (both-EW logistic) fit with the EXECUTED comparison.py procedure (C=1.0 max_iter=1000, StandardScaler base_train only, block sigmoid cal)
baseline_binding.contrast_definition: contrast = P2_lgbm_equal_info - P1_H3_incumbent_refit on identical pooled rows under the same shared draw stream
baseline_binding.per_contrast_interval_reporting: EVERY registered contrast carries its own explicit unadjusted 95% percentile interval plus its own null-centered p-value; no contrast may be registered without interval reporting

registered_contrasts.interval_reporting: EXPLICIT: ci95_unadjusted percentile interval + null_centered p_value emitted per contrast (adapter contrast dict, verified in test_baseline_binding_and_contrast_interval)

baseline_binding.interval_coverage_verification: verified at freeze time: every entry in registered_contrasts has explicit interval reporting (the registered set is exactly {C_lgbm_vs_both_EW_logistic}); the Holm-adjusted family result is reported separately from the ordinary intervals; adding a contrast later requires adding its interval reporting in the same registration

folds.confirm_and_2026_exclusion: confirm_2025H2 excluded - not scored; 2026 rows remain CLOSED (no 2026 loads, no 2026 tuning)

config.output_write_once_note: write-once: the harness refuses to overwrite an existing output dir (WriteOnceError pattern, same as run_comparison); the run creates <output_destination>\<64-hex run_id>\

authorization.note: the standing conditional authorization applies after READY; nothing in this freeze authorizes a run before READY
